<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, inject, type Component, type HTMLAttributes } from 'vue'
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { Primitive } from '../../primitive'

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    as?: string | Component
    asChild?: boolean
    class?: HTMLAttributes['class']
  }>(),
  {
    as: 'button',
  },
)

type BindValue = string | number | boolean | null | undefined | ((...args: never[]) => void)
type CollapsibleApi = {
  getTriggerProps?: () => Record<string, BindValue>
}
const context = inject('collapsible') as { api: CollapsibleApi } | null
const triggerProps = computed(() => context?.api.getTriggerProps?.() ?? {})
</script>

<template>
  <Primitive
    :as="props.as"
    :as-child="props.asChild"
    v-bind="triggerProps"
    data-slot="collapsible-trigger"
    type="button"
    :class="cn(props.class)"
  >
    <slot />
  </Primitive>
</template>

Project Details

This section can be expanded and collapsed.

<view class="{{className}}" data-state="{{api.open ? 'open' : 'closed'}}">
  <!-- Trigger -->
  <view 
    id="{{api.triggerProps.id}}"
    class="collapsible-trigger"
    bindtap="onTriggerTap"
    data-state="{{api.open ? 'open' : 'closed'}}"
    data-disabled="{{disabled}}"
  >
    <slot name="trigger"></slot>
    <text class="collapsible-icon">{{api.open ? '▼' : '▶'}}</text>
  </view>

  <!-- Content -->
  <view 
    id="{{api.contentProps.id}}"
    class="collapsible-content"
    data-state="{{api.open ? 'open' : 'closed'}}"
    hidden="{{!api.open}}"
  >
    <slot name="content"></slot>
  </view>
</view>
